## Corrections applied

1. **Deduplication — narrowed to safely-equivalent only** (US2 scenario 2, FR-007, Assumptions): normalization is now limited to lower-casing the host and ignoring a default port. **Trailing slashes and query/tracking parameters are kept distinct**, since they can point to genuinely different pages.

2. **Literal AND/OR/NOT in search** (US4 new scenario 5, FR-012): putting `"AND"`, `"OR"`, `"NOT"` (or a phrase containing them) in quotes searches them as literal text instead of operators. Precedence (`NOT`>`AND`>`OR`, parens override) unchanged.

3. **Note formatting** — unchanged, as you confirmed.

4. **Import preserves title, tags, and original date-added** where present in the file (US10 scenario 1, FR-026), on top of the Netscape HTML format and folder→tag mapping.

5. **Preserved web page = self-contained HTML** representing the original page (embedding needed resources), *not* an extracted readable version; **PDFs still stored as PDFs** (US11 scenario 1, FR-029, edge cases, Assumptions, Preserved Copy entity).

6. **Unique tag names** (new FR-010a, Tag entity, US3 new scenario 5): a name that already exists (case-insensitive) reuses the existing tag — two tags with the same name can never be created.

---
